first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates that shorter onboarding and simpler signup improved completion, time-to-value, and durable activation. This directly addresses both current declines while aligning with sustainable qualified revenue. Promotional pricing is not preferred despite competitive pressure because prior evidence found materially worse 30-day retention.

final.rationale: Run a guarded onboarding-simplification experiment for SMB simple-workspace accounts only, excluding complex workspaces. The verified evidence shows improved completion, activation, time-to-value, and qualified revenue in the target population, while complex workspaces experienced 9% higher 60-day churn when necessary setup steps were removed. This directly addresses both current declines and is more consistent with sustainable revenue than promotional pricing, whose known retention harm makes it unsuitable as the single priority experiment.
